summary: Round 2 testing — DIAG-SIM, Inspector, knock_pull, deep_link handoffs. Backend: 9/9 new pytest tests passed (test_round2.py) covering /diagsim/scenarios, /diagsim/run+retrieve+list (sample schema + lightweight list verified), /inspector/audit (aggressive 2.0L turbo @500hp @91 scored <80 with critical findings, recommendations populated), /inspector/reports/{id}, real exports producing diagsim sessions persisted in db.diagsim_sessions with deep_link=/diagsim/{sid}, inspector deep_link=/inspector/{rid}, forensic single_generation_audit & two_generation_diff modes, ECU payload completeness, knock_pull_zones top-right -3/-1.5 producing visibly lower ignition cells and floored >=0. Regression: all 13 iteration-1 tests still pass (22/22 total). Frontend: full wizard intake→envelope→generate→review verified, KnockPullEditor present in Review with all 16 cells, top_end_boost preset applies -3°/-1.5° to high-RPM × peak-load zones (cell-3-3=-3, red w/ flame), heatmap visibly shows propagated pull on top-right quadrant, 'Why did this change?' rationale mentions 'Manual knock-pull applied via Knock Pull Editor', knock-pull-clear resets cells to empty/0. Profile saved successfully (URL → /profiles/{id}). ExportPanel: ECU button downloaded JSON 'TEST_R2_UI_<id>.ecuflash.json' as expected.

integration_issues.issue: After clicking export-btn-ecu the dialog state appears to keep the modal in a state where subsequent export buttons (diagsim/inspector) were not immediately re-locatable in the automated run. Manually re-opening between exports works. Likely benign but worth a quick UX check: ensure modal stays open after a download and the other buttons remain interactive without re-opening.

action_items: Optional: in ExportPanel, verify that doing ECU download then clicking diagsim/inspector in the same modal session still works without re-opening. Confirm via manual click-through.

(Not blocking) Frontend DIAG-SIM page (/diagsim/{sessionId}) and Inspector page (/inspector/{reportId}) were not visually confirmed via the automated run because the modal sequencing failed; backend deep_links and required testids are wired up. Recommend quick manual visual check or main agent can self-test by navigating directly.
critical_code_review_comments: diagsim.py: variable `pw_ms` is computed per sample but never used in summary or fault logic — can stay as is for telemetry payload (it IS in samples).
diagsim.py knock heuristic — when timing_cmd < 8 AND load > 120 prob is scaled to 25%; reasonable but could be moved to a named constant.
inspector.py: envelope warnings are re-elevated as findings — possible double-counting if envelope warnings are also surfaced upstream. Not a bug but a stylistic note.
server.py /export endpoint is now ~140 lines — consider extracting per-target handlers into small helpers (export_diagsim/inspector/forensic/ecu) for maintainability.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% — KnockPullEditor + ECU download verified; DIAG-SIM/Inspector deep-link pages not visually confirmed in automated run but routes & testids are present in code and backend deep_link wiring is verified

seed_data_creation: pytest creates TEST_R2_Aggressive, TEST_R2_Forensic and cleans them up. UI run created TEST_R2_UI profile + 1 diagsim session + 1 inspector report + 1 ECU/forensic export (left in DB, harmless).
